title: UAAP: Late Ricario goal fires Adamson to crucial win vs. UST
summary: Adamson University claimed a crucial 2-1 win over University of Santo Tomas in the UAAP Season 89 men's football tournament, Sunday at the UP Diliman Football Stadium.
